name: candidate-seed-fixtures
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.candidate-seed.json; bun test research/bapa/candidate-seed.test.ts research/bapa/candidate-seed-public.test.ts research/bapa/proof-worker.test.ts; bun research/bapa/candidate-seed-symbolic.ts; printf '%s\n' 'feat(bapa): seed symbolic candidates from retained families' > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commit-message.txt"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commit-message.txt"
